item.content:encoded:

Welp, +500. Not really a lot I want to do here, as its a very successful SCP and I don't want to muck that up. Still, a few potential crosslinks can be made. The first, is the mention of MTF Zeta-9 linking out to their spot on the MTF dossier. Additionally, Exit Strategy is a tale that features an 835 that has basically taken over the oceans, and an inline link from here to there would not go amiss. As such, I am recommending the following edits:

Changing this:

On ██-██-████ at ████:██:██ hours, Mobile Task Force Zeta-Niner (Mole Rats) conducted an investigation of SCP-835. At this time, SCP-835 had a mass of only four tons, and only one large polyp at the north end of the structure (designated Polyp Alpha), Polyp Bravo not yet being in existence.

To this:

On ██-██-████ at ████:██:██ hours, Mobile Task Force Zeta-Niner (Mole Rats) conducted an investigation of SCP-835. At this time, SCP-835 had a mass of only four tons, and only one large polyp at the north end of the structure (designated Polyp Alpha), Polyp Bravo not yet being in existence.

Changing this:

SCP-835 emits a large mass of semi-liquid material several times a day from the large polyps on each “end”. This appears to be made of semi-digested solids, fecal material, and semen. This mass also has several forms of virus, bacteria, and parasites, many of which have been found only within SCP-835. The bacterium 835-I5 forms the major concern for containment, due to [DATA EXPUNGED]. This, coupled with the extremely hard “shell” of SCP-835, form a major obstacle to neutralization. Any force capable of “cracking open” SCP-835 would also cause the “slurry” inside to spread, and cause additional infection from 835-I5.

To this:

SCP-835 emits a large mass of semi-liquid material several times a day from the large polyps on each “end”. This appears to be made of semi-digested solids, fecal material, and semen. This mass also has several forms of virus, bacteria, and parasites, many of which have been found only within SCP-835. The bacterium 835-I5 forms the major concern for containment, due to [DATA EXPUNGED]. This, coupled with the extremely hard “shell” of SCP-835, form a major obstacle to neutralization. Any force capable of “cracking open” SCP-835 would also cause the “slurry” inside to spread, and cause additional infection from 835-I5.

If anyone has other/better examples that could be used here please leave a comment saying so!

I remember when this got about 400 up-votes.

Kudos, Clef & Gears.

This was the Albert Fish of SCPs.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
God, this one.

Gears and I were brainstorming and decided that we should make the grossest article of all time. We each came up with a keyphrase. I had just learned what "Santorum" meant, and so I replied with, "A noxious slurry of fecal matter and semen." He submitted, "body horror."

It was Gears' idea to have the horror be revealed in layers: first tell the reader what the thing is, then have them discover the truth of what it's made of. I don't remember who came up with the idea of writing an expunged version, then removing all the expungements: I think it could have been me.

If there were one change I'd make to this article, it's redoing the uncensored logs to remove all the footnotes, and just have the entire log written in plaintext. I may do that some day.
